title: Restore Stage2 shell-to-Pose-Search speed coherence

observed_failure.root_cause: Stage2 introduced a duplicate 60 cm/s kinematic-shell constant after the bridge Pose Search path had been tuned around the existing stabilized 160 cm/s query. The unchanged locomotion database contains approximately 300 cm/s walk root motion. The 60/160 split leaves trajectory history near idle and makes MM_Idle cheaper than every locomotion pose.

hypothesis: Using the existing BridgePoseSearchStabilizedWalkSpeedCmPerSecond as the Stage2 shell speed will make observed trajectory history coherent with the Pose Search future query and restore non-idle selection without forcing an animation by name.
single_behavior_change: Replace the duplicate Stage2AForwardWalkSpeedCmPerSecond constant with a resolver based on the effective BridgePoseSearchStabilizedWalkSpeedCmPerSecond, clamped by BridgeOwnedMovementMaxPlanarSpeedCmPerSecond. Apply it consistently to Stage2 walk, turn, and scripted locomotion shell deltas.
tdd_contract: Default effective settings resolve Stage2 locomotion speed to 160 cm/s, not 60 cm/s.
The shell delta remains bounded by Stage2AMaxWalkDeltaPerTickCm.
Intent magnitude still scales physical shell speed and displacement.
Zero intent still produces zero displacement.
The authoritative scripted Normal episode selects at least one non-idle database animation during moving phases without an asset-name override.
Pose Search assets, schema weights, policy action scales, Physics Control gains, root authority, and selection policy remain unchanged.
next_if_supported: Retune only the scripted phase durations in a separately preregistered scenario revision so path length remains in the locked acceptance band, then run the full causal/control bundle.
